summary: Fresh two-client Chromium verification reached the public TV page but could not create a room. The live page returned HTTP 200 and loaded remote-room-v1.js plus QRCode, while prometeo-tv-room-v1 returned HTTP 500. Supabase function logs for the same run recorded PGRST002: Could not query the database for the schema cache. Pairing therefore could not begin, so layout/overlay/media/refresh/pair/home and tv.state were correctly not claimed as verified.
tests: PASS_PUBLIC_TV_LOAD: GitHub Pages TV URL returned HTTP 200 in representative Chromium.
PASS_CLIENT_BOOTSTRAP_ASSETS: remote-room-v1.js and QRCode were loaded; navigator reported online.
FAIL_ROOM_CREATED: tvPairCode remained creando..., no pair href was produced, and room endpoint returned HTTP 500.
CONFIRMED_BACKEND_ERROR: Supabase function logs recorded PGRST002 schema-cache failure for prometeo-tv-room-v1 during the diagnostic run.
NOT_RUN_REMOTE_JOIN_AND_COMMANDS: pairing could not begin, so remote command and tv.state checks were not falsely marked verified.
PASS_NO_AUTHORITY_MUTATION: no Tele authority pointer or product bytes were promoted or changed.
unresolved: Restore PostgREST/database schema-cache availability for the Supabase project, then rerun the current two-client room verification before claiming pairing or remote-control functionality.
